description: Everything to look at before rendering, measured: the check at each aspect, when it settles and how long it holds still (with a warning when the entrance is slow or the hold too short to read its words), how much of an overlay sits under Reels', Shorts' and TikTok's own interface at 9:16, and a contact sheet per aspect (returned as images, written with a review.md to outDir).

beats.description: Named moments to move, e.g. { "in": 0.4, "out": -0.6 } (negative counts from the end).

code.description: Your own program: plain JavaScript defining function frame(t, $) that returns SVG markup (see motion_api). Give this or `item`.

colors.description: Overrides on the style: hex colours for accent / accent2 / ink (darkest) / paper (lightest) / surface, mode, and faces like "Poppins:800".

item.description: A pack item: "essentials/lower-third", or its id "lower-third" (motion_list shows them). Give this or `code`.

mood.description: A choreography mood: the moves, eases and idles a seed draws from.

motion.description: How each part moves — keys are part names from motion_info, or "*" for every part: { "*": { "ease": "bouncy" }, "name": { "in": "typewriter" }, "plate": { "in": "iris", "out": "wipe", "from": "right" }, "role": { "emphasis": "pulse@2" } }. Settings: in, out (moves from motion_moves), ease, dur, outDur, from, outFrom, distance, blur, idle, emphasis, keys, delay, at, outAt, intensity, origin, split, order, stagger, outStagger.

outDir.description: Where to write the sheets and review.md. Default: volito-review/<id>.

placement.description: For `code`: overlay (transparent, over footage) or full (draws its own ground).

props.description: The item's props (motion_info lists them), e.g. { name: 'Priya Sharma', role: 'Product designer' }. For `code`, any data the program reads as $.data.

seed.description: A new choreography for every number; the same number always moves the same way. Try several.

spec.description: A Graphic spec file (.json with "volito": 1; motion_validate checks one) or a .volito bundle: its item and options are the base, and anything else given here wins. Give this instead of `item` or `code`.

style.description: A built-in brand style (ember, cream, mono, neon, pop, studio, whiteboard, sketch, pastel, pixel, collage, diorama, clay, storybook, cobalt, tomato, acid, candy, riso, aurora, sunset, lime, sport, retro, diner, blueprint, forest, luxe, capsule, memphis, swiss, terminal, vapor, scifi, mint, editorial), a path to a DESIGN.md, or DESIGN.md text.

words.description: Words spoken over the graphic with their start/end seconds — text lands on them.

wordsFile.description: A transcript file instead of `words` ([{w,s,e}] or Whisper JSON).

name: motion_review
title: Review a motion graphic
